xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3164 propose-not-apply stance docs (swarm add-on)

plan.title: docs(main,meta): name directive self-modification stance - self-improving, not self-editing (propose-not-apply)

narratives.Description: Name Directive stance: self-improving through formal gates, not self-editing live rules mid-run (propose-not-apply). Continual-Harness hosts may rewrite prompts mid-run; Directive must not. The refine loop proposes; issues/PRs/quality gates dispose. Parent epic #3179. Related #1200, #2741, #2436, #1307, #607.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want the self-improving not self-editing stance named in main.md or meta, so that future host-capability discussions do not relitigate live gate rewrites.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit the content/main.md file module to add a short propose-not-apply stance paragraph next to the #1200 formal-gates principle: Directive MUST NOT self-edit live operating rules mid-run; refine proposes; issue/PR/quality gates dispose. 2. Cross-link #2741 and parent #3179 in that paragraph; optionally touch content/meta/ files only for a pointer. 3. Add CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry for #3164. 4. Only if consumer-visible: update content/templates/agents-entry.md file and run task agents:refresh. Verify by reading the new section and confirming agents:refresh exit 0 when agents-entry is touched; docs-only story uses verify evidence via file read and agents:refresh.

items.title: Stance paragraph in main.md or meta

narrative.Acceptance: Given content/main.md or designated meta doc, when read, then propose-not-apply is named: self-improving via gates, not live self-edit of constitution/gates.
Given the stance section, when read, then it cites safety-via-gates (#1200), trajectory/refine epic (#2741), and parent #3179 without contradicting existing Rule Authority ladder prose.
Given merge, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then #3164 documents the stance naming.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: Docs-only. Prefer content/main.md if that is SoT for principles; do not invent runtime self-edit machinery. Exclusive of skill #3201 and PR #3200 pilot unless only cross-links.
